title: Crypto World's Fair Hackathon
description: Colosseum's online hackathon (Sep 14 to Oct 12) for builders and founders across all crypto ecosystems to launch startups. $840,000 in prizes across overall awards and ecosystem tracks, including dedicated Tempo and Base tracks. Winners are considered for Colosseum's accelerator ($250,000 pre-seed).
reward: Tempo track $100,000 across 10 products; Base track $25,000 across 5; plus overall awards ($30,000 grand prize, $15,000 each for the next 20 teams)
key_requirement: New startup product built during Sep 14 to Oct 12 that integrates the track's chain

builder_steps.detail: a 2-3 minute pitch video of you
team background, location, and go-to-market answers
a repo (private is fine if shared with Colosseum)

rules: Every member must register on colosseum.com and the team leader must upload the Project Submission before 11:59pm PT on October 12, 2026.
Teams may begin development before the hackathon, but products are judged only on the work completed between the competition's start and end dates.
Builders may use pre-existing code, but teams must disclose all relevant past development work in the submission form.
For new startups that haven't raised significant outside capital, not established companies.
Each person may be on one team; a team may submit one project at a time.
Age of majority or 18+; sanctioned countries and persons are excluded (see the official rules).
Judged on functionality, potential impact, novelty, UX, open-source, and business plan. The portal is treated as a pitch to Colosseum's venture fund.
Track prizes are in addition to the overall awards. Winners are announced on or about December 5, 2026.
All winners are interviewed and considered for Colosseum's accelerator ($250,000 pre-seed, 12 weeks in San Francisco).

submission_requirements.label: A product-demo video of no more than three minutes explaining how the product works

submission_requirements.description: Required if any code predates the hackathon. Misrepresenting development history can mean disqualification.
